first_pass_control.source_contrast: Unlike the running figure (dynamic stride, white-sclera eyes at large head size) and the farm actors (dark-mark eyes at smaller head size, rolled cuffs): Ines stands at rest at a projected head height where white-sclera eyes still read, with turned-back cuffs as a separate owned colour

subject_specs.shape_topology: hair mass → face plane → jacket body → near/far sleeves with cuffs and hands → near/far trouser masses → wedge shoes
subject_specs.material_mapping: jacket mustard with lighter cuffs and one darker far-side plane; trousers teal with darker inner-leg plane; skin one tone plus cheek and ear patches; hair one mass plus a lighter folded lock
specific_negative_rendering: no gradient shading or cloth texture

character_designs.unique_original_identity: Ines: an original adult laundromat customer — short asymmetric bob with one lock folded behind the near ear, mustard work jacket with turned-back cuffs, wide teal trousers; not modelled on any person or source character
character_designs.intended_view: three-quarter facing screen right (threeq_r), full figure, eye level

silhouette.outline_path: crown of the bob rises asymmetrically toward the far side, drops to a near-side lock, steps out to the jacket shoulder line, follows the slightly forward-tilted jacket back to a flared hem, then two wide trouser masses that narrow toward small wedge shoes; the near arm hangs free of the jacket edge so the hand reads against the background
named_masses: bob hair mass over the skull, parent: head
face plane with near ear patch, parent: head
jacket body with collar band, parent: torso
near sleeve with turned-back cuff and hand, parent: jacket shoulder
far sleeve partly behind the jacket, parent: jacket shoulder
near and far trouser masses, parent: hips
near_far_order: near sleeve and hand in front of the jacket edge
far arm behind the jacket body
near trouser mass overlaps the far one at the knee
near ear patch in front of the hair underside

head.skull_contour: compact rounded skull slightly wider at the crown than the jaw, jaw tapering to a small chin on the near side
head.face_plane: three-quarter plane: far cheek clipped by the skull edge, near cheek with one warm patch, nose a small wedge on the far edge
head.hair_outer_path: asymmetric bob: higher on the far side, straight-cut lower edge at jaw level, one lock folded behind the near ear
hair_lobes: folded lock behind the near ear
short fringe edge over the near brow

eye_regions: near eye: white almond opening with a dark pupil
far eye: narrower white opening, partly clipped by the nose wedge
brow_regions: two short angular dark brows, the near one longer
face.nose_region: small darker wedge on the far edge of the face plane
face.mouth_region: short closed line for neutral; separate states open and smile
face.expression_geometry: neutral: brows level, lids relaxed, mouth closed line; curious: near brow lifts, lids open wider, mouth small open oval; satisfied (profile): lids lower, mouth upturned

garment_masses: mustard work jacket: one large filled mass with collar band and turned-back cuffs in a lighter mustard
wide teal trousers with one darker inner-leg plane
body.hand_construction: small mitten-like hand with a separate thumb; for gripping, fingers wrap in front of the held edge and the thumb sits behind it; for pinching, thumb and index tips meet with the other fingers folded
body.support_and_weight: weight on the far foot, near knee relaxed, torso tilted slightly toward the action side

patches: one darker side plane on the far side

no realistic fingers or knuckle wrinkles
